mapper.select: SELECT sc.student_id, s.real_name as student_name, s.student_code as student_number, sc.course_id, c.course_name, sc.grade, sc.enrollment_date, sc.status, c.teacher_id, t.real_name as teacher_name, c.semester, sc.create_time, sc.update_time FROM mg_student_course sc LEFT JOIN mg_course c ON sc.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN mg_student s ON sc.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN mg_teacher t ON c.teacher_id = t.id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} AND s.is_deleted = 0 AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND t.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sc.create_time DESC
